title: test(service-automation): measure a connector definition published on one replica across two replicas (#27977)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加一个测试文件 `connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`,用两个内核(各自 ObjectQLPlugin 元数据协议 + 自动化插件)共享一个 SQLite 文件和一条总线,测量「在 A 上发布改过的连接器定义,B 会不会跟着重建」。不改任何运行时代码。
- 为什么改:#27428 的裁决 6513279565 要求单独测量这一点。结论:B 不跟。lane 2 把变更送到了 B 的协议监听器,但自动化插件的监听只认 `flow`,`metadata:reloaded` 又只在本内核触发,所以 B 一直用旧定义,直到重载或重启。缺口以 `it.fails` 钉住,修复卡是 #28002。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时风险,测试不进发布包(`files` 只发 `dist`)。回滚即删掉这个文件。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`,`it.fails` 那一例和其后的对照例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`,预期 `2 passed | 1 expected fail (3)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One new test file, `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`, built like `connector-credential-cluster.test.ts` (#27941): two `ObjectKernel` replicas, each running `ObjectQLPlugin`'s metadata protocol and `AutomationServicePlugin`, over ONE better-sqlite3 file both open, joined by a bus that delivers every publish to every subscriber (publisher included). Each replica is attached the way `MetadataClusterBridgePlugin` attaches it at `kernel:ready`: lane 2 (`attachMetadataMutationPubSub`) and lane 4 (`attachConnectorCredentialPubSub`). Lane 1 (`metadata.changed`) is not attached: it replays into a `MetadataManager`'s caches, and the connector reconcile reads the ObjectQL registry and the protocol's execution view, never that manager.

A definition change is published on A through the per-item door (a draft `saveMetaItem`, then `publishMetaItem`), changing `providerConfig.endpoint` from V1 to V2.

## Measurement

| | result |
|:--|:--|
| A, the publishing replica | re-materializes with V2 (ObjectQLPlugin announces A's own `metadata:reloaded` after the per-item publish) |
| lane 2 to B | delivered: B's protocol replays `connector/NAME` into B's mutation listeners |
| B's live instance, no reload on B | **does not converge**: B's provider is never called (`expected undefined to be 'https://v2.billing.example.test'`) |
| control: `metadata:reloaded` on B | B materializes V2 from its own read of the shared store |

Cause, read from the code: `subscribeFlowMutations` in `plugin.ts` returns early for any mutation whose type is not `flow`, and `metadata:reloaded` is a kernel-local hook a peer never receives. So the gap is the trigger, not the store or the read. The lane choice for the fix belongs to #28002.

## Tests

- `connector-definition-cluster.test.ts`: `Tests 2 passed | 1 expected fail (3)`.
  - Harness health, a plain `it`: A converges and lane 2 reaches B. This keeps the `it.fails` from passing on a broken harness.
  - The gap, `it.fails` naming #27977 and #28002: B converges with no reload on B. Its failure was read with the case temporarily run as a plain `it`: the one assertion that fails is B's last endpoint, `undefined` instead of V2.
  - Control, a plain `it`: B holds no instance before the reload, and holds V2 after it.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: `Test Files 222 passed (222) · Tests 2832 passed | 1 expected fail (2833)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Side finding, same root, measured with a throwaway probe that is not committed: a direct active save (`saveMetaItem` with no mode, what `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name` calls) does not re-materialize even on the writing replica. A stayed on V1 after saving V2, and its listeners heard the mutation. The seat recorded it on #28002.
- No changeset (`skip-changeset`): the package publishes only `dist`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation build`, `grep` for the test's names in `dist` gave 0 hits, and the positive control `AutomationServicePlugin` gave 4 files.
